summary: Iteration 11 — verified all 4 backlog items: (1) Pydantic Literal validators reject invalid type/send_timing with 422, (2) per-campaign LeadMagnetOverride CRUD round-trips and is correctly used over workspace when inherit:false (returns scope:'campaign'), (3) workspace falls back when override.inherit:true (scope:'workspace'), (4) engagement-map + recent-opens endpoints return correct shape with seed lead 69e081b5cd724a3d376691c4 (4 views, is_hot=true), Dashboard brochure-opens-alert renders + click navigates to /leads/{id}, LeadInbox row-hot-{leadId} badge + red strip render. WhatsApp Cloud API graceful logged-only fallback works (no 500). WhatsApp webhook GET returns 503 (env empty) and POST accepts payload returning {received:true}. 14/14 new tests + 22/22 regression tests = 36/36 backend tests passing. All UI flows verified.

minor.issue: Currently returns 503 because WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN is intentionally blank in /app/backend/.env. Confirmed graceful behavior; before going live the founder must set the token in env. Documented in product copy expected.

minor.endpoint: send_lead_magnet (auto + manual) when channel='whatsapp' with WA env empty
minor.issue: Subject prefix 'Lead magnet queued (WhatsApp logged-only — set WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN+PHONE_NUMBER_ID)' is logged correctly; no crash. Inbound webhook regex '$regex': from_phone[-9:] is greedy (could match unintended phone substrings); consider switching to exact normalized-digits comparison.

ui_bugs.issue: The clickable row inside [data-testid=brochure-opens-alert] does NOT carry the row-level data-testid 'brochure-open-row-{leadId}' described in the spec. Selector that worked: alert > button. Add data-testid='brochure-open-row-{leadId}' to each row for stable test selection.

passed_tests: PUT /api/lead-magnets/campaign/{id} round-trips inherit:false override (url, name, send_timing)
POST /api/leads/{id}/send-lead-magnet with campaign override inherit:false returns scope:'campaign'
POST /api/leads/{id}/send-lead-magnet with override inherit:true returns scope:'workspace'
GET /api/lead-magnets/engagement-map returns {leads:{lead_id:{sent_count,view_count,is_hot,last_sent,last_viewed}}, total_engaged} — seed lead present with is_hot=true
GET /api/lead-magnets/recent-opens?limit=5 returns enriched leads with first_name+company_name+view_count, deduped by lead_id
POST /api/leads/{id}/send-lead-magnet stays 200 with sent:true even when WhatsApp env empty (logged-only fallback, no 500)
GET /api/webhooks/whatsapp returns 503 when WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN env empty
POST /api/webhooks/whatsapp accepts sample inbound payload and returns {received:true}
Regression: 22/22 lead_magnet + ttv tests still pass (login, /api/leads, /api/ttv/milestones, onboarding/status, magnet config, upload, send+track+engagement, ttv shape)
Frontend: Dashboard renders [data-testid=brochure-opens-alert] with '1 lead just opened your brochure' + Public FormUser/Form Corp/4× HOT row
Frontend: Clicking the row navigates to /leads/69e081b5cd724a3d376691c4 (lead detail loads with HOT badge + Pre-Call Brochure card + Sent 10× / Opens 4)
Frontend: LeadInbox renders [data-testid=row-hot-69e081b5cd724a3d376691c4] inline badge ('4× hot') with red→purple left strip; existing 20 rows render normally
action_items: (LOW) Add data-testid='brochure-open-row-{leadId}' attribute on each row inside [data-testid=brochure-opens-alert] for stable selectors. Currently only the parent has a testid — the child row uses a generic button.
(LOW) WhatsApp webhook receive: regex match on from_phone[-9:] could collide with unintended leads. Switch to normalized-digits exact compare or last-10 with anchor.
(deferred) server.py is now 3666 lines — splitting into modules (lead_magnet.py, whatsapp.py, ttv.py, leads.py, etc.) is overdue but explicitly out-of-scope per problem statement.

(production-blocker, but env-only) Set WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN / WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID / WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN in /app/backend/.env before going live; currently empty for graceful logged-only fallback as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: Literal['url','file'] and Literal['pre_booking','post_booking','both'] correctly enforce payload validation on both LeadMagnetConfig and CampaignLeadMagnetOverride — verified by 422 tests.

_resolve_magnet_for_lead correctly prefers campaign override only when inherit=False; otherwise falls back to workspace. Magnet doc carries scope:'workspace'|'campaign' which is returned in send response — clean and testable.

send_whatsapp_text guards on _whatsapp_configured() and returns {sent:False, error:'not_configured', logged_only:True} without raising; manual+auto send handlers branch correctly to label activity subjects appropriately. No 500s.

engagement-map aggregation pipeline uses {kind, lead_id} group then merges send/view counts in Python — correct but O(N) per dashboard load. Acceptable now; consider materializing per-lead engagement summary if leads grow >10k.
recent-opens dedupes by lead_id keeping latest view (sorted DESC + first-seen) — correct.
WhatsApp webhook receive regex {'$regex': from_phone[-9:]} is fragile; use normalized digits with anchor or store leads.phone_normalized for exact match.
_build_tracking_url now reads BACKEND_URL which IS set in .env (carried over from iter10 fix) — tracking URLs are absolute. Confirmed.
Dashboard alert row missing per-row data-testid is a minor testability gap but not a functional bug.
